title: Does Financial Speech Need Continual Learning Regularization? A Study of EWC and mini-KFAC on Earnings Call ASR
abstract: arXiv:2610.13432v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Earnings call transcription presents a realistic continual learning scenario where Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are updated with new recordings but risk catastrophic forgetting of previously learned financial speech patterns. Adapting Whisper-small from a general-domain speech corpus to the Earnings22 benchmark reveals the opposite: all evaluated methods exhibit improvement on held-out financial speech from the same domain during adaptation rather than forgetting. This task complementarity makes regularization counterproductive. Nevertheless, when regularization is warranted, a layer-wise mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (mini-KFAC) approximation seems to achieve lower word error rates (WERs) and more stable optimization than standard diagonal Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC). The results suggest that task complementarity should be assessed before applying continual learning constraints, and prefer mini-KFA

translated_title: 金融语音需要持续学习正则化吗？EWC与mini-KFAC在财报电话会议语音识别上的研究
translated_abstract: 财报电话会议转录呈现了一个现实的持续学习场景：自动语音识别（ASR）系统在用新录音进行更新时，存在灾难性遗忘之前学到的金融语音模式的风险。将Whisper-small从通用领域语音语料库适配到Earnings22基准的实验却揭示了相反的结果：所有被评估的方法在适配过程中对同领域保留集的金融语音表现出提升而非遗忘。这种任务互补性使得正则化反而适得其反。然而，当正则化确有必要时，逐层的mini-Kronecker-Factored近似曲率（mini-KFAC）方法似乎比标准的对角弹性权重固化（EWC）实现了更低的词错误率（WER）和更稳定的优化。研究结果表明，在应用持续学习约束之前应先评估任务互补性，并优先选择mini-KFAC。
tldr: 该研究发现在将Whisper适配到财报电话会议语音识别时，新任务与旧任务之间存在互补性而非灾难性遗忘，因而正则化反而有害；但当确需正则化时，逐层mini-KFAC比对角EWC能取得更低的词错误率和更稳定的优化效果。
en_tdlr: Adapting Whisper to earnings call ASR reveals task complementarity rather than catastrophic forgetting, making regularization counterproductive; when regularization is warranted, layer-wise mini-KFAC achieves lower WERs and more stable optimization than diagonal EWC.
